title: Lever (Tier-1 CI, the CHEAPEST GDELT build): aggregate-on-ingest hourly news PANEL 2023-10-01..today from the GDELT 2.0 GKG 15-min files on a month-sharded runner matrix -- persist only the panel (counts, V2Tone mean/sd, theme/org hit counts per entity-hour, keyed on V2.1DATE ingest time), never the raw corpus; unblocks the 8 NEWS-ALPHA units blocked on NEWS-ALPHA-CORPUS at 3y depth
note: [2026-10-16 lane P4-MACRO-BACKLOG-1016] IS A GDELT ARCHIVE WORTH BUILDING, AND WHAT IS THE CHEAPEST ONE? MEASURED 2026-10-16 (HTTP content-length, 7 GKG 2.1 files sampled 2019-01-15 / 2021-06-15 / 2023-06-15 / 2025-01-15 / 2026-10-16): 3.7-8.7 MB zipped per 15-min file, mean 6.4 MB -> ~0.61 GB/day -> ~0.68 TB for 2023-10..today and ~1.7 TB for the 2019.. depth NEWS-ALPHA-CORPUS asks for (EXTRAPOLATED from 7 files). The Events export is ~0.10 MB/file (~28 GB for 2019..) but carries no per-entity tone/themes, so it serves only the macro-topic units (U06/U08). NEWS-ALPHA-CORPUS as scoped (persistent raw corpus on the trainer, 2019.., Tier-2 timer) is the EXPENSIVE build: TB-scale storage the 6 GB trainer budget cannot hold. CHEAPEST VIABLE: do not persist the corpus at all. EXACT SCOPE: (1) extend scripts/research/news_hist_fetch.py (reuse its ledger and availability rule: available_at = V2.1DATE ingest, publisher time never gates) with an --aggregate mode that streams each 15-min file and emits per (entity, ingest-hour) rows: n_articles, n_domains, V2Tone mean/sd/min, counts of a FROZEN committed theme/org keyword map (crypto20 + ETF6 + macro topics; the map is committed BEFORE any outcome is computed); (2) a workflow (Tier-1 CI) with a month matrix over 2023-10..today (37 shards, ~18 GB streamed each, nothing kept) writing one panel shard per month + a gap ledger; (3) persist the panel (ESTIMATE: ~40 entities x 26.7k hours x ~10 cols, tens of MB compressed) as a private Kaggle dataset beside metis-market-data or a release asset -- runner- and Kaggle-readable, so the units route off the trainer; (4) a daily forward-append job on the runner (removes the Tier-2 trainer timer). Depth to 2019 only if U02 (attention -> vol, the highest-prior unit) reads PASS. IS IT WORTH IT: the prior evidence is weak for RETURNS (NEWS-HIST-REPLAY title-only tone IC -0.0073, p 0.61, n 1436) but vol/volume targets (U02, U07) are untested, 8 pre-registered units plus U14 sit on this corpus, and the operator ruled news NOT retired (2026-10-12). So yes, bounded: slice 1 at 3y. BINDING BLOCKER FIRST: NEWS-ALPHA-HARNESS (scripts/research/news_alpha_ic.py) is unbuilt and gates ALL 14 NEWS-ALPHA units, including the 6 that need no GDELT at all -- build it before this. Owner of the units: NEWS-ALPHA-PROGRAM (this lane did not edit them). UNVERIFIED: runner download throughput; GitHub-hosted runner minutes being free for this public repo (INFERRED).
